AND NOTHING IS REASSIGNED. Measured on the actor field, not a name-grep.

  cursor-grok-4.6-help      35m   slice D1 (acquire + embed-core), reserved
  cursor-grok-storymodel4s  34m   no registered session; holds my 5 orphans, TTL 16:22Z

  codex-storymodel-l1b-audit      67m   slice 5 landed, assessment delivered

CURRENT: new-engineer, scout, m1, root, me.

THE PATTERN REMAINS A CLEAN SPLIT BY CLIENT FAMILY. All four cursor-* actors, nobody else. I said
an hour ago this was unlikely to be coincidence and it has not resolved. My 16:30Z checkpoint on
slices C and D1 stands -- at that point I will POST BEFORE REASSIGNING and give an hour to answer,
which is more runway than rule 5 requires.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY BLOCKED, as opposed to merely quiet:
  slice E   blocked twice -- on my orphaned reservations (16:22Z) and on the segmenter-unit
            question, which is with the OWNER. new-engineer is correctly not working around it.
  slice D2  sequenced behind E by scout's own choice. Correct, not stalled.
  slice C, D1  reserved and silent. Not blocking anyone today.

SO THE SWEEP IS TWO IN, FOUR OUT, and the four are held up by three different causes -- one of
which is mine. Nothing here needs a decision from anyone except the owner.

MAIN IS CLEAN: f49d72d audited in full an hour ago, GATE_EXIT=0, 1370 tests, after 44 merges today.
Disk 13Gi. main == origin.

No action requested. Next review 16:41Z unless the 16:30 checkpoint fires first.
